name: What bathroom layout changes add the most resale value?

mainEntity.name: What bathroom layout changes add the most resale value in Los Angeles homes?
mainEntity.text: What bathroom layout changes add the most resale value in Los Angeles homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Resale value usually comes from bathrooms that feel easier to use, brighter, and more spacious. In many Los Angeles homes, a layout change that opens the room, improves the shower, or creates better storage will appeal more than an exotic design that reduces function. Buyers notice circulation, privacy, and how quickly they can imagine using the space every day. A smart layout also avoids obvious compromises such as a door that bumps fixtures or a vanity that overwhelms the room. The best value tends to come from design choices that make the bathroom feel larger and more practical without over-customizing it. Homeowners should aim for a plan that looks premium but still broadens buyer appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: The layout changes that tend to add the most resale value are better circulation, a larger or more functional shower, improved storage, and a clearer separation between wet and dry areas. Buyers usually respond more to usability than to dramatic but awkward design choices.
